flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, UP to riverview (stored 'not waterfront'), plotted from rec.gov per-site coordinates on Esri imagery: the west row (101-104, 107, 110) sits on open grass facing the Des Moines River tailwater, about 15-40 m pad to water over a riprap bank. A paved or gravel path or road runs along the bank between pads and water (imagery can't say which), so not riverfront under the no-driveways rule. The river is well over 30 m wide here. Pads below the dam get no lake value (rec.gov: 'just below the Red Rock Dam ... on the north side of the Des Moines River'), so the call is the river only. Rest of the 135 sites are inland under trees. No per-site water tag at Howell in rec.gov (Ivans has them).
